text.content:
Heywood's real mayor.

Role: Leader of the Valentinos (Ganger 9)
Affiliation: Valentinos
Where to find them: Vista del Rey
Known for: Never having been photographed holding a gun

Seventy, gentle-voiced, courteous, ruthless and utterly in control. Under him the Valentinos keep their code in Vista del Rey and wage their war with 6th Street. He respects the cause of the Princesses of Justice, and makes sure nobody follows a runaway into Princessland.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04, 05, 10
